scenes.title:

original points.
scenes.subtitle: A visual interface for 3D annotation.
scenes.narration: Nearly sixty million original points. How can a vision language model annotate a three dimensional scene through observation? Meet WireSight.

scenes.title:
Make height
visual evidence.
scenes.subtitle: Top-down discovery / exact recorded selection paths
scenes.narration: Start with a top down height view. Position and elevation become visual evidence. The observer identifies five elongated traces and specifies their paths in the image.

scenes.title:
Look again.
Resolve the question.
scenes.subtitle: Top views expose paths / side views expose sag
scenes.narration: A top view separates the wires. A side view reveals sag and supports. The observer requests the perspectives needed to resolve its spatial questions.

scenes.title:
Visual decisions.
Original point IDs.
scenes.subtitle: Explicit image regions → multiview intersection → point labels
scenes.narration: Visual decisions become explicit image regions. The executor retains depth and original record IDs, and maps multiview selections back to three dimensional points.

scenes.title:
Insufficient evidence?
Keep it unknown.
scenes.subtitle: Real local revision: support + unobservable → retract
scenes.narration: Candidates are reviewed before they are committed. In this recorded example, the second view is ambiguous. The observer retracts the pending additions.

scenes.title:
From observed images
to labeled 3D points.
scenes.subtitle: Five main wires / two transverse cables
scenes.narration: The frozen result contains five main wires and two transverse cables. Every annotated point is retained, with gaps preserved.

scenes.title:
Freeze first.
Evaluate the full scope.
scenes.subtitle: GridNet-HD / t1z5b development-scene point metrics
scenes.narration: On this development scene, precision is about ninety nine point nine nine percent, and recall is ninety seven point three eight. Unconfirmed targets still count as misses.

scenes.title:
Bring visual reasoning
to 3D annotation.
scenes.subtitle: Task-driven observation / original-point execution
scenes.narration: The idea is a visual interface for three dimensional annotation. Reuse existing visual understanding, let questions guide observation, and keep original point execution auditable.

scenes.title:
Inspect. Reproduce.
Build on the interface.
scenes.subtitle: Offline demo / real geometry / frozen labels / recorded decisions
scenes.narration: The release includes a demo, real geometry, frozen labels, recorded actions, and replay tools. Inspect the evidence, reproduce the result, and build on the interface.
